notes: Every request carries its version in `_meta` as `io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion`, mirrored in the `MCP-Protocol-Version` header.
`Mcp-Method` must equal the body's `method`; for `tools/call`, `Mcp-Name` must equal `params.name`.
Clients that open with an `initialize` handshake are answered too, for protocol versions 2025-11-25, 2025-06-18, 2025-03-26.
Set `Authorization: Bearer <admin token>` when the server requires it.
Generated from the tool catalog — edit `catalog.rs`, not this file.

tools.description: Get server name, base URL, and totals for the indexed library: file counts by type, total size, playlist count and database size. A good first call to learn what this server holds.
tools.name: get_server_stats
tools.title: Server statistics

tools.description: List the configured media directories this server indexes. Call this before browse_folder: the roots are the only paths guaranteed to be browsable, and they cannot be guessed.
tools.name: list_library_roots

available.description: False when the root is missing — an unplugged drive, usually. Its files stay indexed but cannot be played.

path.description: Pass to browse_folder to list this root

tools.title: List library roots

tools.description: Full-text search across filenames, titles, artists, albums, genres, composers and — where available — fetched synopses. Results are ranked by relevance. Multi-word queries match all words; the last word also matches as a prefix, so "beethov sym" finds "Beethoven Symphony". This is the right tool when you know roughly what you are looking for.

category.description: Restrict to one media type. Defaults to 'all'.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page

query.description: Words to search for. Punctuation is ignored.

tools.name: search_media

stream_url.description: Direct HTTP URL for playback, with range support

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page; null when exhausted

tools.title: Search the library

tools.description: Page through every indexed file, optionally filtered by category. Use search_media when you know what you want; this is for surveying the whole library.

category.description: Restrict to one media type. Defaults to 'all'.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page

tools.name: list_media

stream_url.description: Direct HTTP URL for playback, with range support

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page; null when exhausted

tools.title: List library files

tools.description: List one directory's immediate subfolders and files. Call list_library_roots first to get a valid starting path. Results are paged: a folder with thousands of files returns them a page at a time.

category.description: Restrict files to one media type. Defaults to 'all'.

path.description: Absolute folder path, from list_library_roots or from the `path` of a folder in a previous result

tools.name: browse_folder

stream_url.description: Direct HTTP URL for playback, with range support

tools.title: Browse a folder

tools.description: Full metadata for one file: tags, audio stream properties, playable URLs, and any synopsis, rating or artwork fetched from an online metadata provider.

file_id.description: Numeric id from any listing or search result

tools.name: get_media_info

stream_url.description: Direct HTTP URL for playback, with range support

tools.title: Media file details

tools.description: List the distinct artists, albums, album artists, genres or years in the music library, each with a track count. Answered from an index, so it is cheap on a large library — prefer it over listing every file and grouping them yourself.

artist.description: With kind='album', list only this artist's albums

genre.description: Restrict the results to one genre

tools.name: list_music_categories
tools.title: List music categories

tools.description: Find tracks by exact tag values, combining any of artist, album artist, album, genre and year. Use list_music_categories first to learn the exact spellings — these match exactly, unlike search_media.

limit.description: Maximum tracks to return (defaults to 200, maximum 500)

tools.name: find_music

stream_url.description: Direct HTTP URL for playback, with range support

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page; null when exhausted

tools.title: Find music by tag

tools.description: List every playlist on the server with its id, name and description.
tools.name: list_playlists
tools.title: List playlists

tools.description: List a playlist's tracks in playback order.
tools.name: get_playlist_tracks

stream_url.description: Direct HTTP URL for playback, with range support

tools.title: Playlist tracks

tools.description: Create an empty playlist and return its id. Add tracks with add_to_playlist.
tools.name: create_playlist
tools.title: Create a playlist

tools.description: Append media files to a playlist, in the order given. Pass every id in one call rather than calling repeatedly.

media_file_ids.description: File ids, in the order they should play

tools.name: add_to_playlist
tools.title: Add tracks to a playlist

tools.description: Replace a playlist's running order. The ids given become positions 0, 1, 2 and so on.

media_file_ids.description: Every track id, in the new order

tools.name: reorder_playlist
tools.title: Reorder a playlist

tools.description: Remove one media file from a playlist. The file itself is untouched.
tools.name: remove_from_playlist
tools.title: Remove a track from a playlist

tools.description: Delete a playlist and all of its entries. The media files themselves are untouched. This cannot be undone.
tools.name: delete_playlist
tools.title: Delete a playlist

tools.description: List the DLNA, Chromecast and AirPlay devices discovered on the local network. Use the `id` for every other renderer tool — friendly names are not unique and can change, ids do not.
tools.name: list_renderers
tools.title: List playback devices

tools.description: Ask a renderer what it is currently playing, and report what this server last sent it. Call this after casting to confirm playback actually started.

renderer_id.description: Stable id from list_renderers. Omit to report every renderer this server has an active cast on.

tools.name: get_playback_status
tools.title: What is playing

tools.description: Start playing one media file on a renderer. Get `file_id` from a search or listing and `renderer_id` from list_renderers.
tools.name: cast_media_to_renderer
tools.title: Cast a file to a device

tools.description: Play a playlist on a renderer, starting at `track_index` and advancing automatically as each track finishes.
tools.name: cast_playlist_to_renderer
tools.title: Cast a playlist to a device

tools.description: Play everything in a folder on a renderer, in natural filename order, without creating a permanent playlist.

media.description: Restrict to one kind. Omit to cast everything castable.

path.description: Folder path, as returned by browse_folder

tools.name: cast_folder_to_renderer
tools.title: Cast a folder to a device

tools.description: Play, pause or stop what is already on a renderer. Stopping tears the session down, which is what a push protocol like AirPlay audio needs.
tools.name: control_renderer
tools.title: Control playback

transport: Streamable HTTP — a single POST /mcp on the server's main port
